defmodule DockdCLI.Commands.Instance.Up do
  @moduledoc """
  Installs a package (if not already installed) and idempotently brings its
  instance up in one command.

  Wraps `Dockd.up/2`. Unlike `instance run`, `up` never waits to tear the
  container down — it ensures the instance is running and returns, leaving it
  in place.

  ## Args

  `args[:package]` — the package reference to bring up (required). Resolved the
    same way `apply_package` resolves names: a bare name against the packages
    root, or a `/`-containing path / `.json` file directly.
  `args[:source]` — a git URL to install the package from when it isn't already
    installed. Ignored when the package is already present.
  `args[:name]` — instance name override (defaults to the package's own name).
  """

  alias Dockd.Instance
  alias DockdCLI.Json
  alias DockdCLI.Output

  @spec run(map(), keyword()) :: :ok | {:error, term()}
  def run(args, opts) do
    with {:ok, ref} <- require_package(args) do
      case Dockd.up(ref, up_opts(args) ++ opts) do
        {:ok, summary} -> report(summary)
        {:error, %Dockd.Error{} = err} -> {:error, Exception.message(err)}
      end
    end
  end

  @spec run_json(map(), keyword()) :: :ok | {:error, term()}
  def run_json(args, opts) do
    with {:ok, ref} <- require_package(args) do
      case Dockd.up(ref, up_opts(args) ++ opts) do
        {:ok, %{package: package, action: action, instance: instance}} ->
          Output.json(Map.merge(Json.instance(instance), %{package: package, action: action}))

        {:error, err} ->
          {:error, err}
      end
    end
  end

  defp require_package(args) do
    case Map.get(args, :package) do
      ref when is_binary(ref) and ref != "" -> {:ok, ref}
      _ -> {:error, "Usage: dockd instance up --package NAME [--source URL] [--name NAME]"}
    end
  end

  defp up_opts(args) do
    []
    |> put_present(:source, args[:source])
    |> put_present(:name, args[:name])
  end

  defp put_present(opts, _key, value) when value in [nil, ""], do: opts
  defp put_present(opts, key, value), do: Keyword.put(opts, key, value)

  defp report(%{package: package, action: action, instance: instance}) do
    name = Instance.short_name(instance)
    if package == :installed, do: Output.info("Installed package.")
    Output.info(action_message(action, name))
    Output.info("\nOpen a shell with:\n\n    dockd instance shell --name #{name}")
    :ok
  end

  defp action_message(:created, name), do: "Created and started #{name}."
  defp action_message(:started, name), do: "Started #{name}."
  defp action_message(:running, name), do: "#{name} is already up to date and running."
  defp action_message(:recreated, name), do: "Package spec changed - recreated #{name}."
end
